exercises.question: Which connector introduces the first event? [¿Qué conector introduce el primer acontecimiento?]
options: Primero [First]
Posteriormente [Subsequently]
Finalmente [Finally]

exercises.sentence: __, algunos testigos informaron de una luz extraña. (primero) [First, some witnesses reported a strange light.]
exercises.english: First, some witnesses reported a strange light.
Subsequently, a brief recording appeared on social media.

sentences: Primero llegaron los testimonios. [First the testimonies arrived.]
Posteriormente apareció una grabación. [Subsequently a recording appeared.]
Finalmente, los investigadores publicaron un comunicado. [Finally, the investigators published a statement.]

exercises.question: Which connector means «subsequently»? [¿Qué conector significa «posteriormente»?]
options: posteriormente [subsequently]
primero [first]
mientras [while]

exercises.sentence: Finalmente, los investigadores explicaron qué había __. (suceder) [Finally, the investigators explained what had happened.]
exercises.english: Finally, the investigators explained what had happened.
While the journalists were investigating, new rumours began to circulate.

exercises.sentence: Primero llegó la información de los testigos; posteriormente apareció una grabación.
options: First the information from witnesses arrived; subsequently a recording appeared.
First a recording disappeared; subsequently the witnesses arrived.
The recording arrived before the witnesses and then disappeared.

exercises.sentence: Mientras los periodistas investigaban, comenzaron a circular nuevos rumores.
options: While the journalists were investigating, new rumours began to circulate.
The journalists stopped investigating because the rumours disappeared.
The rumours investigated the journalists.

exercises.sentence: Después de que apareció el vídeo, más personas contaron lo que habían visto.
exercises.english: After the video appeared, more people told what they had seen.

exercises.sentence: Finalmente, los investigadores explicaron qué había sucedido.
options: Finally, the investigators explained what had happened.
First, the investigators predicted what would happen tomorrow.
The investigators refused to explain the event.
Primero llegaron los testimonios de los vecinos. [First the neighbours' testimonies arrived.]
Finalmente llegaron los testimonios de los vecinos. [Finally the neighbours' testimonies arrived.]
Posteriormente llegaron los testimonios de los vecinos. [Subsequently the neighbours' testimonies arrived.]
Posteriormente apareció una grabación breve. [Subsequently a brief recording appeared.]
Primero apareció una grabación breve. [First a brief recording appeared.]
Posteriormente aparecerá una grabación breve. [Subsequently a brief recording will appear.]
Finalmente, los investigadores explicaron qué había sucedido. [Finally, the investigators explained what had happened.]
Primero, los investigadores explicaron qué había sucedido. [First, the investigators explained what had happened.]
Finalmente, los investigadores explicarán qué había sucedido. [Finally, the investigators will explain what had happened.]

template.prompt: Put three stages of a news story in order using connectors.
template.answer: Primero aparecieron los testimonios, posteriormente surgió una grabación y finalmente los investigadores publicaron un comunicado.

template.prompt: Describe how a story developed from the first report to a later explanation.
template.answer: Primero los testigos informaron de lo ocurrido, posteriormente apareció un vídeo y finalmente los investigadores explicaron qué había sucedido.
